individual-data-points.explanation: Continuous stacked-area representation of median state frequencies across many promoter bins (n=5912 promoters); overlaying individual promoter values across this continuous binned ribbon plot would be unreadable, analogous to a line/stream plot.
Single-molecule stack is a heatmap-like display in which every row already is an individual molecule's methylation trace, so individual data are inherently shown.

Box plot; box plots are exempt from requiring overlaid individual data points since they already show the distribution (and outlier points are additionally shown here).
Box plot; exempt from the individual-data-point requirement, distribution and outliers already shown.
